scientific_integrity: Computations are exhaustive within the specified finite domain and independently cross-checked using polar refinements, exact Jacobian ideals and extension point counts. Claims of independent validation or historical uniqueness are not made.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification concerns only unmarked pencils of quadratic surfaces over F2, with geometric smoothness over the algebraic closure. It is not a general finite-field or historical-priority theorem. The full text of Bruen-Hirschfeld (1988) was unavailable; its accessible abstract covers pencils with non-absolutely-irreducible base curves.
title: Two projective types of smooth elliptic bases for all-smooth binary quadric pencils
